result.title: UNISON: A Unified Framework for Learning from Scored Bags
result.summary: We introduce UNISON, a unified framework that bridges multiple instance learning and recommendation systems by treating both as instances of learning from scored bag collections of (item, score) pairs. Unlike traditional approaches that address bag-level classification and personalized recommendation as separate problems, UNISON decomposes learning into three interconnected stages: (1) learning universal item representations, (2) modeling bag-specific preference patterns through lightweight personalized parameters, and (3) inferring bag-level characteristics from learned preferences. We justify the architectural choice of linear bag-specific scoring through a first-order analysis: when item embeddings are sufficiently smooth in the score, a linear function approximates the score up to a Taylor remainder controlled by the curvature of the underlying preference function. For cold-start scenarios, we show that the cold-bag fitting problem reduces to ridge-less linear regression with a closed-form solution, and provide convergence guarantees for the iterative variant. Empirically, UNISON matches or outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse domains: entertainment (books, movies), immunology (T cell receptor (TCR) based classification), and microbiome, offering superior computational efficiency and interpretability. A controlled synthetic experiment further confirms that the bag-specific parameters ($w_j, b_j$) recover the latent factors that drive item scores even when the projection $φ$ has no access to the original scoring mechanism (AUC > 0.998). UNISON is available at https://github.com/louzounlab/UNISON.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UNISON 统一框架，把多示例学习与个性化推荐都看作对「(例项, 分数) 包集合」的学习，分三阶段学习通用物品表示、轻量包特定偏好与包级推断，并对线性包打分给出泰勒余项分析、冷启动闭式解与迭代收敛保证，在书籍、电影、TCR 分类和微生物组等任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其中「由示例级分数反推包级特征、并恢复驱动分数的 latent 因子」的思路，可能可供核查视觉证据聚合与贡献分配，以及线性聚合近似何时成立。
